paragraphs: My favorite teacher is Miss Li. She is tall and thin. She is of medium height, about 165 centimeters. She has long straight black hair and big bright eyes. She has a round face and a small nose. She always wears a pair of glasses.

Miss Li is an English teacher. She is very kind and friendly to her students. She is also a great singer. She sings English songs in class. The students all love her because she makes the class fun and easy.
Why do I like Miss Li? Because she is patient and always helps us. She looks beautiful and smart. I think she is the best teacher. I want to be a teacher like her one day.

questions.q: What does Miss Li look like?
opts: She is of medium height and heavy.

Why do the students love Miss Li?
opts: Because she makes the class fun.

questions.q: Does Miss Li wear glasses?
What is the passage mainly about?
opts: How to become an English teacher.
Describing my favorite teacher Miss Li.
Why English is an easy subject.

paragraphs: This term, our school has a new art teacher. His name is Mr. Wang. He is a great artist. He is tall and strong, and he has short curly hair. He has a friendly face and always smiles at us.

Mr. Wang is very popular at school. Do you know why? Because he teaches in a funny way. He draws many pictures on the blackboard and tells interesting stories. He also shows us how to use colors well.
His class is always full of laughter. He wears a colorful shirt and a pair of blue glasses. He looks like a real actor on a stage. The students describe him as a kind person and a good friend.
I like Mr. Wang because he is patient. When I draw badly, he says, "Don't worry. Practice makes perfect." He is strict but fair. I think he is the best art teacher.

questions.q: Who is the new art teacher?
Why is Mr. Wang popular at school?
opts: Because he teaches in a funny way.

questions.q: What does Mr. Wang look like?
What does the word "strict" mean in Chinese?
What does Mr. Wang say when a student draws badly?

reading_c.provenance: 真题母本改编（教师授权原创 2026-08-08）
reading_c.绑定: G37 be vs have/has / G39 形容词 / 外貌科普
paragraphs: People look different in many ways. Why? Because of their height, weight, hair and face. Some people are tall, and some are short. Some are thin, and some are heavy. This is normal.
Your hair can be straight or curly. It can be black, brown, yellow or red. Some people have long hair, and some have short hair. Your eyes can be big or small. They can be black, brown or blue.
Your face shape is also different. Some people have a round face, and some have a long face. Your skin can be light or dark. You get these looks from your parents, so you look like your family.
Why is it important to look different? Because it makes the world colorful. Everyone is special in his or her own way. We should not judge a person by his or her appearance. Be kind to everyone.

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
Where do people get their looks from?
What can your hair be like?
What does the word "judge" mean in Chinese?
What should we do according to the passage?

sa.title: 阅读表达
paragraphs: My Good Friend Lily
Lily is my good friend. She is of medium height and quite thin. She has long curly black hair and a round face. She has big blue eyes and a small mouth. She always wears a red dress.
Lily is a famous singer. She sings very well. Many people like her because her voice is beautiful. She is also a kind person. She often helps old people carry heavy bags.
Why is Lily popular? Because she is friendly and always smiles. She looks pretty and smart. I think she is a great person.

writing.title: 书面表达
writing.prompt:
假如你是李华，请你用英语写一篇90词左右的短文，介绍你最喜爱的一位老师的外貌和喜欢他的原因。内容包括：
1. 这位老师是谁、教什么学科；
2. 他的外貌（身高、头发、眼睛、脸等）；
3. 你喜欢他的原因（至少2点，用 because 说明）。
sample: My favorite teacher is Mr. Zhang. He teaches us English. He is tall and strong, and he has short black hair. He has a round face and big eyes. He always wears a pair of glasses.
I like Mr. Zhang because he is very kind and patient. When I make mistakes, he always helps me with a smile. He also teaches in a funny way, so his class is full of laughter. He is strict but fair.
Mr. Zhang looks like a great actor on the stage. He is a good teacher and a good friend. I want to be a teacher like him one day.
writing.requirements: 1. 词数约 90 词；2. 包含所有提示要点；3. 语句通顺，意思连贯，语法正确；4. 可适当发挥。
